groups.activity: unlock the Zariman and The Holdfasts
groups.meta: The New War → Angels of the Zariman
conditions: Angels of the Zariman is the only progression gate. Cavalero sells Laetum at Holdfasts Neutral; no syndicate rank-up is required.

groups.sub: Chrysalith: turn Voidplumes in to Archimedean Yonta
groups.meta: one thorough mission funds the blueprint

rows.label: Voidplume Pinion
rows.note: build requirement; dormant Angel drops one

conditions: Each Zariman map has eight Voidplume pickups: one Crest, two Vanes, and five Down-or-Vane spawns. Turn plumes in to Yonta for standing.
The daily cap is 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank; at MR 14 it is 23,000, so 3,000 standing is not a calendar gate.
Wake and kill the dormant Void Angel statue to guarantee the Pinion. Void Armageddon's Ravenous Angel gives a Quill instead, not a Pinion.
Do the objective before the sweep when running a bounty: failing it forfeits collected plumes.
bonuses: Loot radar plus container-breaking coverage finds plumes quickly. Parallax Orokin Eye marks plumes and Accolades directly on the HUD.
Lost Spirits lead to nearby plumes or Accolades; Volt Speed makes them run faster.

disclosures.title: the gun is a short Zariman visit
disclosures.body: Halako Perimeter is preferred because it has no timer and lets you finish the objective before a relaxed full-map sweep. The rank grind players warn about belongs to later Holdfasts rewards, not Laetum itself.

conditions: Neutral has a 5,000 standing capacity, enough to buy the blueprint immediately after one good plume sweep.
You may craft Laetum before Mastery Rank 14, but cannot equip it until then.

groups.meta: apply a perk before the next tier tracks

rows.label: Void Angel primary-fire headshots without reloading
Solo mission with Incarnon weapons in every slot

conditions: Return to Cavalero and apply each unlocked perk before the next evolution begins tracking.
Evolution III uses the untransformed pistol's primary fire. Reloading any weapon breaks the headshot streak; holster Laetum between Angels instead.
For the fallback Evo III route, use magazine capacity and multishot, reduce damage enough not to kill the Angel early, and let multishot pellets supply the eight headshots.
Exalted weapons do not qualify for Evolution V. Incarnon Genesis weapons do qualify.
bonuses: Mag's Magnetize can make Evolution III complete from one shot into a woken Angel; a Mag squadmate can provide the bubble.
Laetum, Felarx, and Innodem are a convenient native-Incarnon set for Evolution V.

disclosures.title: Evolution III is the real wall
disclosures.body: The weapon itself is a one-evening acquisition. Evo I and II are quick, Evo IV needs Void Flood rotations, and Evo V is one solo mission once your loadout qualifies. The Angel headshots are the frustrating step without Magnetize or a deliberate multishot setup.
